shortDescription: Set network WEB parameters in WTI OOB and PDU devices

options.name: cpm_password
options.description: This is the Password of the WTI device to send the module. If the cpm_username is blank, this parameter is presumed to be a User Token.

options.name: cpm_url
options.description: This is the URL of the WTI device to send the module.

options.name: cpm_username
options.description: This is the Username of the WTI device to send the module. If this value is blank, then the cpm_password is presumed to be a User Token.

options.name: harden
options.description: Security level for the WEB the device will respond to 0 = Off, 1 = Medium, 2 = High.

options.name: hsts
options.description: If HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS) is enabled/disabled for the WEB.

options.name: httpenable
options.description: Activates unsecure WEB for the specified interface.

options.name: httpport
options.description: Port used by the insecure WEB.

options.name: httpsenable
options.description: Activates secure WEB for the specified interface.

options.name: httpsport
options.description: Port used by the secure WEB.

options.name: inter_filename
options.description: Intermediate Certificate to be assigned to the Device.

options.name: interface
options.description: The ethernet port for the SNMP we are defining.

options.name: ocsp
options.description: Current state of the Online Certificate Status Protocol (OCSP) for the Web Server.

options.name: private_filename
options.description: Private Certificate to be assigned to the Device.

options.name: signed_filename
options.description: Signed Certificate to be assigned to the Device.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Inactivity timeout of a user when logged into the web server (valid from 0 to 9999 minutes) 0 is no timeout.

options.name: tlsmode
options.description: Which TLS the WEB will use 0 = TLSv1.1, 1 = TLSv1.1/TLSv1.2, 2 = TLSv1.2/TLSv1.3, 3 = TLSv1.3

options.name: trace
options.description: Current state of TRACE requests for thw Web Server.

options.name: use_https
options.description: Designates to use an https connection or http connection.

options.name: use_proxy
options.description: Flag to control if the lookup will observe HTTP proxy environment variables when present.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If false, SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.

options.name: webterm
options.description: Current state of the CLI over Web for the Web Server.
